title: Brutal theme (WordPress)
lede: Justin Jackson’s open-source WordPress theme, made to carry the plain-page ideas of his essay “This is a web page”.
summary: A 2016 one-column WordPress theme: monospace body, small headings, square bullets, no decoration.

creator.name: Justin Jackson, after a design by Kyle Fox

evidence.note: Read the README and `style.css` on GitHub on 2026-10-02. Repository created 27 September 2016 (GitHub API). The bundled `screenshot.png` is only 600 × 450 px, so the look is not recorded as observed.

styles.note: Partial fit: a one-column monospace page with tiny headings, but with a set font (Roboto Mono) and a fixed column instead of raw defaults.

context: README: “A brutalist WordPress theme”, “inspired by two of my essays”: [This is a web page](https://justinjackson.ca/words.html) and “I’m a fucking websmaster”. “The original design came from Kyle Fox.”

`style.css` sets `font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace; font-size: 16px; max-width: 46em`, `h1 { font-size: 1.5em }`, `h2 { font-size: 1.2em }`, `h3 { font-size: 1em }`, and square list bullets. Theme tags: one-column, light.
[NN/g (2017)](ref:nngroup-brutalism-antidesign-article-2017) cites Justin Jackson’s blog for “the black and blue Monospace typography often seen in brutalist sites”.

interpretation: Shows how small the type scale of the style is: here the largest heading is only 1.5 times the body.
